{{Top|leg}}
The '''T-15''' was a model of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive generator]] in the same series as the [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14]] and [[T-17 hyperdrive generator|T-17]]. [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] had at least one of each of these models in his junkyard in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
